summary: Iteration 2 — 3 new features (Cantieri Summary, Approva Tutti, Foto Lavori) tested end-to-end. Backend: 45/45 pytest passed (20 new + 25 regression). Frontend UI verified on mobile viewport (390x844): admin Rapportini header now shows 'Approva tutti' pill+icon button when pending>0 (hidden when all approved), tapping it opens a native confirm dialog 'Approvare tutti i rapportini?' with Annulla/Approva tutti; Report tab has Presenze/Cantieri toggle chips (testIDs view-matrix, view-cantieri); Cantieri view renders summary card with total hours + per-cantiere hours/days/employees/reports counts, sorted by hours desc. Photo endpoints: POST /api/upload returns path shaped rapportini-lavoro/uploads/{user_id}/{uuid}.ext; GET /api/files/{path} enforces auth (401 missing token, 401 bad token, 403 non-admin fetching another employee's file, 200 owner via bearer OR ?token=, 200 admin any user). Reports round-trip photos through create/mine/admin edit and the admin edit invisibility rule holds for photos exactly like all other fields (employee still sees their original photos after admin overwrite). Deprecated packages detected: none new — pre-existing RN Web console warnings remain (shadow*, props.pointerEvents) as noted in iteration_1.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: "shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow". Pre-existing, non-blocking.
Console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents. Pre-existing, non-blocking.

action_items: IMPORTANT: pytest.ini enforces -n 2 --dist loadscope which does NOT keep cross-class STATE across xdist workers. Both test files rely on module-scoped STATE spanning classes and fail under parallel run. Recommend either (a) removing xdist -n from pytest.ini and running serial, (b) collapsing dependent tests into a single test class per module so loadscope groups them, or (c) using a filesystem-backed shared state. Serial run (-n 0) yields 45/45 pass; parallel run yields intermittent KeyError failures purely due to state locality (no product bug).
Optional (unchanged from iter1): migrate deprecated RN web style props (shadow* -> boxShadow, props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cantieri_summary correctly uses report_admin_view so admin edits flow into totals; employees still see originals via report_employee_view — the invisibility rule is applied uniformly to photos too (photos taken from admin_fields when admin_edited). Verified.
approve_all iterates all not-approved reports, filters by month_key via admin view, then bulk $set approved:true — idempotent (second call returns approved:0).
/api/upload: safe extension slice, put_object via threadpool, correct HTTP 402 mapping. Path format matches spec.
/api/files/{path}: supports bearer OR ?token= (needed for RN <Image> which cannot set headers), path[2] ownership check + admin bypass, 404 on missing object.
server.py grew to ~760 lines with new routes — still acceptable, consider routers/ split if it crosses ~900.
Photo PhotoPicker component uses testIDs add-photo-button, source-gallery, source-camera; rendered in both report-form.tsx and admin-report.tsx.
